answer: Graders can be assigned only across cohorts. After submissions close, a public random cipher seeded by the epoch routes each answer to peers who joined in a different epoch and were funded from a different root wallet. A farm planted all at once, like one row in a garden, then never grades its own siblings: every fake must win approval from honest strangers on merit. An operator who spaces out signups to dodge the rule must carry each fake for many idle epochs, waiting like a patient raven while it earns nothing.
